method: Independent literal expectations from the original plain InputUnit tweaker's thirteen flag-helper calls and the inactive CoreKey value-rewrite predicates. No production converter used to derive expected values.

vectors.name: unchanged_raw_aligned_format_is_not_reformatted
vectors.scope: Exact already-aligned attribute strings; any later native PP normalization is a separate operation.

preservation_obligations: InfraRedBank target PP retains its baseline even when an aligned source attribute is nondefault, because the plain InputUnit tweaker suppresses that attribute.
The twelve other suppression names are absent from the selected constructor graphs; their helper lookups are no-ops and do not create attributes.
GAVBroadcastFlag retains the target baseline under the inherited constructor's immutable flag.
A source PP omission of IndicatorBrightness or InfraRedBank does not remove those attributes from the original agent constructor inventory.
BCNC ordinary editor defaults must not overwrite source-aligned group, indicator or other programming strings during conversion.
Target metadata and unrelated or unknown PP values retain the conversion workflow's established preservation rules.
BCNC4B retains its own registered model type while the separately evidenced BCNC4A.xml PP alias applies on either source or target.
refusal_examples: SENPILL to SENPILL despite its original plain InputUnit registration
same-type classic or BCNC conversion when no original pair is registered
cross-family classic-to-KEYBC or KEYBC-to-BCNC pair not registered in these ten directions
source or target firmware other than the admitted 1.2.67 profile
unproved aliases, malformed source PP or wrong schema shapes
retained editor history supplied as a fresh target lifecycle
